style_prompt: clean 2D cartoon animation still, friendly preschool TV cartoon look, bold rounded shapes, soft cel shading, expressive faces, simple readable backgrounds, consistent character design, bright but not pastel watercolor, 9:16 vertical frame, no text, no watermark

image_generation.style_prompt: clean 2D cartoon animation still, friendly preschool TV cartoon look, bold rounded shapes, soft cel shading, expressive faces, simple readable backgrounds, consistent character design, bright but not pastel watercolor, not crayon texture, not vector placeholder art, 9:16 vertical frame, no text, no watermark
image_generation.composition: 9:16 vertical mobile frame, medium close-up on the current speaker for dialogue lines, face and hands visible, simple background with one story prop, stable character design
image_generation.lighting: bright clear cartoon lighting, playful but calm preschool animation mood
image_generation.constraints: no readable text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark, no scary content, no realistic child likeness, no extra characters unless explicitly named
image_generation.continuity_rule: Preserve the same clean cartoon world, stable character proportions, same outfits, and same recurring props across all shots.
image_generation.character_rule: Only show characters explicitly named in the scene; avoid parents, extra siblings, pets, crowds, or random background children unless the scene specifically asks for them.

character_bible: Define the protagonist and supporting cast here before image generation. Keep names, outfits, age range, and key props stable. Avoid extra parents, siblings, pets, or background children unless explicitly required by the episode.

caregiver.instructions: Kind Korean adult caregiver voice. Calm, practical, warm but slightly formal.
caregiver.image_focus: a medium close-up of the caregiver speaking calmly with a practical teaching gesture

friend_1.instructions: Friendly Korean supporting child or older-sibling voice.
friend_1.image_focus: a medium close-up of the first friend speaking cheerfully, clear expression and simple background

friend_2.instructions: Friendly, upbeat Korean supporting character voice.
friend_2.image_focus: a medium close-up of the second friend speaking clearly, with one relevant story prop nearby

guide.instructions: Gentle Korean guide or fairy-teacher voice. Careful and encouraging.

royal_child.instructions: Polite Korean young royal or friend character. Soft, curious, friendly, not formal or stiff.

clock.instructions: Deep friendly Korean clock voice. Slow, rounded, storybook-like.
